name: Education
description: Higher education, K-12, and workforce training.

hasDefinedTerm.name: LMS
hasDefinedTerm.description: Learning management system. The platform hosting courses, assignments, and grades.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SIS
hasDefinedTerm.description: Student information system. The system of record for enrolment, records, and transcripts.

hasDefinedTerm.name: enrollment
hasDefinedTerm.description: The count of registered students, and the primary institutional revenue driver.

hasDefinedTerm.name: yield rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of admitted applicants who enrol.

hasDefinedTerm.name: melt
hasDefinedTerm.description: Admitted students who commit but never arrive.

hasDefinedTerm.name: retention rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of students continuing from one year to the next.

hasDefinedTerm.name: persistence
hasDefinedTerm.description: Whether a student continues in higher education anywhere, not only at one institution.

hasDefinedTerm.name: completion rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of a cohort finishing their programme within a defined window.

hasDefinedTerm.name: attrition
hasDefinedTerm.description: Students leaving before completion.

hasDefinedTerm.name: accreditation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Recognition by an authorized body that an institution meets defined standards.

hasDefinedTerm.name: articulation agreement
hasDefinedTerm.description: A formal arrangement letting credits transfer between institutions.

hasDefinedTerm.name: credit hour
hasDefinedTerm.description: The standard unit of academic workload.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cohort
hasDefinedTerm.description: A group progressing through a programme together.

hasDefinedTerm.name: asynchronous learning
hasDefinedTerm.description: Study without fixed meeting times, completed on the student's schedule.

hasDefinedTerm.name: synchronous learning
hasDefinedTerm.description: Instruction delivered live at a scheduled time.

hasDefinedTerm.name: blended learning
hasDefinedTerm.description: Combining in-person and online instruction.

hasDefinedTerm.name: competency-based education
hasDefinedTerm.description: Progression by demonstrated mastery rather than time served.

hasDefinedTerm.name: microcredential
hasDefinedTerm.description: A short, targeted qualification certifying a specific skill.

hasDefinedTerm.name: stackable credential
hasDefinedTerm.description: A qualification that counts toward a larger one later.

hasDefinedTerm.name: bootcamp
hasDefinedTerm.description: An intensive short programme focused on job-ready skills.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CEU
hasDefinedTerm.description: Continuing education unit. A standard measure of professional development.

hasDefinedTerm.name: FAFSA
hasDefinedTerm.description: The US application determining eligibility for federal student financial aid.

ctx.expansion: Free Application for Federal Student Aid

hasDefinedTerm.name: financial aid package
hasDefinedTerm.description: The combination of grants, loans, and work-study offered to a student.

hasDefinedTerm.name: net price
hasDefinedTerm.description: Published cost minus grant aid. What a student actually pays.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Title IV
hasDefinedTerm.description: The US federal student aid programs, and the compliance regime attached to them.

hasDefinedTerm.name: FERPA
hasDefinedTerm.description: The US law governing the privacy of student education records.

ctx.expansion: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act

hasDefinedTerm.name: Title IX
hasDefinedTerm.description: The US law prohibiting sex discrimination in federally funded education programs.

hasDefinedTerm.name: IPEDS
hasDefinedTerm.description: The US federal data collection all participating institutions must report to.

hasDefinedTerm.name: student outcomes
hasDefinedTerm.description: Measured results after study, such as completion, employment, and earnings.

hasDefinedTerm.name: learning outcome
hasDefinedTerm.description: A stated, assessable description of what a student should be able to do.

hasDefinedTerm.name: formative assessment
hasDefinedTerm.description: Assessment during learning, used to guide teaching rather than grade it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: summative assessment
hasDefinedTerm.description: Assessment at the end of a unit, used to judge achievement.

hasDefinedTerm.name: rubric
hasDefinedTerm.description: A published scoring guide making assessment criteria explicit.

hasDefinedTerm.name: differentiated instruction
hasDefinedTerm.description: Adapting teaching to varied readiness and needs within one group.

hasDefinedTerm.name: IEP
hasDefinedTerm.description: Individualized education program. A legally required plan for a US student with a disability.

hasDefinedTerm.name: EdTech
hasDefinedTerm.description: Technology built for teaching, learning, and institutional operations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: program page
hasDefinedTerm.description: The page describing a course of study. The highest-intent page in education search.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Course schema
hasDefinedTerm.description: Structured data describing a course's provider, delivery mode, and credential.

hasDefinedTerm.name: nontraditional student
hasDefinedTerm.description: A learner outside the school-leaver profile: older, part-time, working, or returning.

hasDefinedTerm.name: workforce development
hasDefinedTerm.description: Training aligned to identified employer demand in a region.
